The mention '庾' is a surname-only reference to 庾亮, used in the phrase '庾即送直' (Yu immediately sent the payment). This directly follows the earlier mention of 庾亮 in the same passage, and the context makes clear it refers to the same person who was just named in full. The main text provides direct evidence for this identity.
